io.milvus.pool

Class PoolClientFactory<C,T>

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.apache.commons.pool2.BaseObject
      • org.apache.commons.pool2.BaseKeyedPooledObjectFactory<String,T>
        • io.milvus.pool.PoolClientFactory<C,T>
  • Type Parameters:
    C - the client config type, such as ConnectParam or ConnectConfig
    T - the client type, such as MilvusClient or MilvusClientV2
    All Implemented Interfaces:
    org.apache.commons.pool2.KeyedPooledObjectFactory<String,T>

    public class PoolClientFactory<C,T>
extends org.apache.commons.pool2.BaseKeyedPooledObjectFactory<String,T>
    Keyed factory that creates, wraps, validates and destroys Milvus client objects for an Apache Commons Pool keyed by endpoint.

    The factory discovers the client constructor and lifecycle methods (close and clientIsReady) reflectively from the client class name. A default config is used for keys without a dedicated config.

      • PoolClientFactory

        public PoolClientFactory(C configDefault,
                         String clientClassName)
                  throws ClassNotFoundException,
                         NoSuchMethodException
        Creates a pool client factory for the given default config and client class name.
        Parameters:
        configDefault - the default config used for keys without a dedicated config
        clientClassName - the fully qualified name of the client class
        Throws:
        ClassNotFoundException - if the client class or its config class cannot be found
        NoSuchMethodException - if the client class lacks the constructor or lifecycle methods
